description: Software engineering, machine learning, data engineering, music, building stuff!
summary:
We developed an iPhone app 'COSMO' with a local, on-board language model wellbeing chatbot that uses sentiment analysis to track user's mood, and attitude. The app will suggest actionable wellbeing improvement tasks based on the user's conversation with the language model. The app will show sentiment analysis statistics and charts.

The app can track and identify behvioural and mental wellbeing changes through rolling average sentiment analysis. 

This app could help astronauts self-identify changes in mental wellbeing and take action much earlier. It could also be applied to other fields too - a participant suggested within prisons to identify changes in prisoners.
details:
Tech stack: Swift, Apple Foundation Models, SwiftUI, iOS, iPhone developed in Xcode.

I had read in recent years that Apple were baking in language, and other models directly into their OS and realised this project was the perfect opportunity to explore these resources within an application. The key piece of interest was running all these models locally, on-device. Meaning no 3rd party connections required.

We focused on the mental helath aspects as identified by the NASA resources realising there are already lots of existing physical health applications that could be adapted.
